title: Recuperating From a Severe Illness
description: As Anna has been recovering from her illness, she's finally started playing all around the city again. However, Anthony can't seem to find her anywhere...

mainQuestExcel.title: Recuperating From a Severe Illness
mainQuestExcel.description: As Anna has been recovering from her illness, she's finally started playing all around the city again. However, Anthony can't seem to find her anywhere...

dialogs.text: Oh, that girl, where has she run off to this time...
Anna's gone out to play again?
Really, how can you be so unperturbed?
Anna's become less and less obedient. I turn around for one second, and she just slips away.
She hasn't fully recovered yet! Please help me find her.
Alright.
Thank you.
Ah, right. Anna always told me that she wanted to see the statue of the Anemo Archon.
I remember that Sister Grace goes there often.
You could go ask her first. Maybe she's noticed something...
Have you looked around?
Of course. I even searched outside the city!
But still, no luck. So I could only turn to you.
What does she like to eat?
Well, she's fond of... Hey! Haven't I told you to stop treating her like a cat?
In any case, she loves all sorts of food, more than I can count.
Okay, I'm counting on you to look for her. I'll be waiting for you here. I'm so tired, I feel like I could collapse...
If I had a wind glider, I'd try flying from up here, just to see how it feels.
So you really can see all of Mondstadt from up here...
Don't catch a cold, now.
Wah! You gave me a fright, where'd you come from?
I bet my brother's looking for me again. Haha, I knew he wouldn't find me here.
I know, I know. I get it, I'll go back in a while. I won't make him worry.
Have you found Anna already?
She's on the Anemo Archon statue's hand.
The—The Anemo Archon statue's hand? How did she even get up there?
I'll head there immediately, get her to come down, and scold her a bit.
My thanks. Please, take these.
If I had a wind glider, I'd try flying from up here, just to see how it feels.
Hasn't this child always been ill? So how...
Have you seen a certain girl...
Ha... You must be referring to Anna. Look up — she's in the hands of the Anemo Archon statue.
Honestly, I was quite stunned when she ran past me. I mean, she's been ill all this time, so where did she get this much energy from?
By the time I recovered, she'd already gone all the way up to the Anemo Archon statue's hands.
You're... not angry?
Angry? Well, I was a little angry. But that child has always been tormented by her sickness...
Seeing her healthy like this... How do I say this? I just can't get angry.
That said, the wind is very strong up there. I hope she doesn't catch a cold...
Where's Anna gone this time? How did I not see before that she could be this much of a handful?
So you really can see all of Mondstadt from up here...
Don't catch a cold, now.
Wah! You gave me a scare. Where did you pop out from, and how did you find me?
I was so sure no one would find me here...
Ah, right. Sister Grace must have told you where I am. She's always around here.
A lot of the medicine I've taken in the past were sent over by her.
Sister Grace is a wonderful person... But I don't want to stay in Mondstadt forever.
Alright, I know my brother's looking for me. I'll head back soon, so he doesn't worry.
Where's Anna gone this time? How did I not see before that she could be this much of a handful?
The wind is very strong up here. I hope that child doesn't catch a cold...
Have you managed to find Anna?
She's on the Anemo Archon statue's hand.
The—The Anemo Archon statue's hand? How did she even get up there?
Ah, we've made trouble for Sister Grace again. I mean, we always do, but...
I'll head there immediately, get her to come down, and scold her a bit.
My thanks. Please, take these.
If I had a wind glider, I'd try flying from up here, just to see how it feels.
The wind is very strong up here. I hope that child doesn't catch a cold...
